list.text: \f[faceprofElm]\bHi, \PN!\nI've been waiting for you!
\f[faceprofElm]\bDo you know anything about my research?
\f[faceprofElm]\bAs you know, Pokémon are carried in Poké Balls these days.
\f[faceprofElm]\bBut before the Poké Ball was invented, people used to walk with Pokémon.
\f[faceprofElm]\bPoké Balls are great because you can carry many Pokémon.
\f[faceprofElm]\bBut walking with Pokémon must have some advantages.
\f[faceprofElm]\bIt could have something to do with how Pokémon grow or evolve...
\f[faceprofElm]\bSo I'm going to give you a Pokémon!
\f[faceprofElm]\bCan you walk beside this Pokémon, outside of its Poké Ball?
\f[faceprofElm]\bTo see if this brings any special feelings or bonds between Pokémon and people?
\f[faceprofElm]\bThe device over there has some Pokémon you could choose from...
\f[faceprofElm]\bOh, hey! I got an email!
\f[faceprofElm]\b...\nHm... Uh-huh... OK...
\f[faceprofElm]\bHey, listen.\nI have this acquaintance that people call Mr. Pokémon.
\f[faceprofElm]\bHe keeps finding weird things and raving about his discoveries.
\f[faceprofElm]\bAnyway, I just got an email from him saying that this time it's real.
\f[faceprofElm]\bIt's probably just another Pokémon Egg, but we're still so busy with our Pokémon research...
\f[faceprofElm]\bWait!\nI know!
\f[faceprofElm]\bYou can go in our place, right?\nCan we count on you?
\f[faceprofElm]\bYou can choose one of the Pokémon over there.
\f[faceprofElm]\bIf a wild Pokémon appears, let your Pokémon battle it!
\f[faceprofElm]\bHow do you like walking with your Pokémon? It's not bad, is it?
\f[faceprofElm]\bYou can take it all the way to the Mr. Pokémon's house.
\f[faceprofElm]\bIf your Pokémon gets hurt...
\f[faceprofElm]\bYou should heal it with this machine.
\f[faceprofElm]\bIt's so easy to use.\nYou just need to press a button on it!
\f[faceprofElm]\bMr. Pokémon goes everywhere and find rarities.\nHis house is past Cherrygrove City.
\f[faceprofElm]\bGo north a little past Cherrygrove.
\f[faceprofElm]\bI'm counting on you, \PN!
\f[faceprofElm]\bOh! I forgot to give you my number!
\f[faceprofElm]\bI'll call you if something comes up!
\f[faceprofElm]\bMr. Pokémon goes everywhere and find rarities.\nHis house is past Cherrygrove City.
\f[faceprofElm]\bGo north a little past Cherrygrove.
\f[faceprofElm]\bI'm counting on you, Victor!
\bWho are you?\nWe are investigating the case of the missing Pokémon here...
\bRule number one!\n"Whoever did it will come back to the site."
\bOh my... So you must be...\nthe one who did it?
\bOh, but you don't have red-hair as one of the witnesses said.
\bWhat?\nYou battled a boy like that?
\bHe must be the one who dit it...\nDid you happen to get his name?
\bI see! So \v[111] was his name.
\bThanks for helping my investigation!
\bMy next assignment is to search for this red-haired individual.
\f[faceprofElm]\b\PN, this is terrible...
\f[faceprofElm]\bOh, yes, what was Mr. Pokémon's big discovery?
\PN handed the Mystery Egg to Professor Elm!
\f[faceprofElm]\bHuh?\nThis is an...Egg, isn't it?
\f[faceprofElm]\bThis Egg may be something I've never seen...still it's just an Egg.
\f[faceprofElm]\bMr. Pokémon is always fascinated by Eggs.
\f[faceprofElm]\bWell, since he gave it to us, we might as well find out what secret it holds.
\f[faceprofElm]\bI'll keep it for a while to find out about the Egg.
\f[faceprofElm]\bWhat?!
\f[faceprofElm]\bProfessor Oak gave you a Pokédex?
\f[faceprofElm]\b\PN, is that true? Th-that's incredible!
\f[faceprofElm]\bHe is superb at seeing the potential of people as Trainers.
\f[faceprofElm]\bWow, \PN.\nI knew you were a little different.\nThings are going to be fun!
\f[faceprofElm]\bYour Pokémon seem to really like you, so why don't you...take the Pokémon Gym challenge?
\f[faceprofElm]\bIf you manage to defeat all the Gym Leaders, you'll eventually challenge the Pokémon League Champion!
\f[faceprofElm]\b...Or not! Ha ha!
\f[faceprofElm]\bBecoming the Champion is not at all easy, but you can certainly challenge Violet City's Gym.
\f[faceprofElm]\b...\PN. Challenging the Gyms scattered around will be a long journey.
\f[faceprofElm]\bTake this to help on your journey as well.
\f[faceprofElm]\bBefore you leave, make sure that you talk to your mom.

lines: This will define which dialogue you'll have with Professor Elm
- based on the Togepi Egg hatching or not.
The first part is related to the initial dialogue,
and then the rules about the Togepi Egg follow it.

then.text: \f[faceprofElm]\bI'm super happy with your participation in the World Cup, everyone in Newbark Town is very proud of you!
\f[faceprofElm]\bYou probably want go to meet Prof. Oak in his laboratory now, right?\nDo you know how to get there?

\f[faceprofElm]\b Follow the same path you took for the Indigo League, but before entering on the Victory Road, go east to reach Viridian City. \nOnce you get there, go straight south to arrive in Pallet Town!
\f[faceprofElm]\bCongratulations on the Indigo League Championship!\nYou won it just in time to secure a place in the next World Cup that will start soon!
\f[faceprofElm]\bIt happens every 4 years in Pokétopia!
\f[faceprofElm]\bYou'll be the youngest one in the next edition!\nThat's remarkable!
\f[faceprofElm]\bThe ship will not leave immediately, so use this time to train for the World Cup.

\f[faceprofElm]\bNow that you are the new Champion, I'm sure a lot of people will be looking for a rematch!\nThis includes the Gym Leaders...\nI'm sure they will use their full power this time, so be prepared.
